what_is_checked: Every non-empty player cell on the Packers chart carries a jersey-number prefix
note: The brief's first named failure. Raw string is retained in raw_cell for review.

what_is_checked: Stripping the jersey number and re-joining it reconstructs the raw cell exactly
expected: reconstruction == raw for every non-empty cell
note: Guards against a regex that eats part of a name (e.g. 'J. Michael Sturdivant').

what_is_checked: A player occupying more than one slot is recorded in each slot, not merged into one
expected: 2 rows for Kitan Oladapo (S rank 2 twice)
note: Confirms a chart slot is not a unique-per-player assignment.

what_is_checked: Slots naming more than one rank-1 player are flagged as groups, not collapsed to a starter
expected: count reported and every such slot keeps every name
note: GB's 2026-11-18 chart has no multi-name rank-1 slot; the guard is still exercised on the general case.

what_is_checked: Empty cells are preserved as empty, never filled with an inferred player
note: GB: WR rank 2 and 3 blank, PR rank 1 blank.

what_is_checked: No slot contains two ranked players at the same rank
note: A duplicate rank would be a co-starter the club never named.

what_is_checked: Rendered rank is not a jersey-number sort (the rejected shortcut, SG-05)
expected: at least one multi-player slot whose jersey numbers are not ascending
observed: 5 of 21 multi-player slots happen to be ascending
note: Proves column order carries information the jersey number does not.

what_is_checked: No Houston Texans depth cell is recorded from the published image
note: https://www.houstontexans.com/team/depth-chart renders its chart as a raster image; the brief requires an authorised structured source, not transcription by eye.

what_is_checked: The club's own 'Unofficial' label is carried on every published row
note: A club chart is not an official league depth order.

what_is_checked: Row-count pin on the raw capture (drift alarm)
note: Pinned so a partial re-read cannot pass as a full one.

observed: DEFENSE (33 cells), OFFENSE (36 cells), SPECIAL TEAMS (18 cells)
